title: Aggregation gap fusion and root-cause linker for usage telemetry
creator: Asha Patel
description: Problem: transient aggregation gaps and intermittent late arrivals in the usage/cost/latency pipelines are generating noisy, duplicated, or misleading anomaly alerts in the Console. Existing detectors flag token-level or tenant-level spikes but lack reconciliation with pipeline-level lineage and ingestion health signals, causing toil for on-call and false positives during known upstream maintenance. Goal: build a signal-fusion layer that (1) correlates metric anomalies with ingestion/aggregation health (Kafka offsets, Flink job lags, batch window completeness), (2) reconciles late-arriving events and re-scores prior alerts when aggregates change, and (3) links alerts to a probable root cause (ingest lag, schema change, model rollout, autoscaler) with actionable RCA context and a one-click runbook link.
acceptance_criteria: A fusion service ingests metric anomalies and pipeline health events and emits a single fused incident per tenant/route with confidence score
Late-arrival reconciliation: within a 48h slack window, pipeline re-aggregation triggers a re-evaluation and marks correlated alerts as reconciled or escalated
Root-cause suggestion populated with at least three candidate causes and associated telemetry (e.g., Kafka lag > X, recent deployment tag, billing export schema change)
Alert noise reduced by at least 30% on the test tenant cohort without lowering detection of real incidents (measured by precision/recall on labeled incidents)
Playbook links and a runbook stub surface in the Console alert panel and in PagerDuty events
implementation_notes: Design a lightweight fusion microservice in Go, deployed to Dedicated infra; unit of correlation = <date-window, tenant, metric-route>
Use event sourcing pattern: consume anomaly events from anomalies-topic and pipeline-health events from ingest-health-topic; store correlation state in DynamoDB with TTL
Scoring: combine normalized z-score of metric with ingestion-lag penalty and schema-change flag to compute final confidence (weights tunable via Console)
Late-arrival handling: buffer window of 48h; if re-aggregation delta > 5% re-open or modify incident and append reconciliation note
RCA heuristics: rule-based first pass (lag threshold, release tag present, recent autoscaler adjustments) + ML classifier later if we have labeled RCA corpus
Alert deduplication: cluster by topological path and tenant; include parent route hash to avoid duplicate paging across routed shards
comments: 2026-02-28 - Asha Patel: Created initial design stub. Prototype approach uses anomalies-topic + ingest-health-topic fusion. Decided on 48h reconciliation window based on billing export cadence.

2026-03-02 - Liam O'Connor: Spike built to consume both topics locally; observed frequent duplicate alerts during nightly compaction. Proposing TTL state store keyed by tenant+route+day to reduce re-processing.

2026-03-04 - Priya Menon (SRE): Reviewed early design; recommended adding schema-change detector and signal from billing-export service. Also recommended conservative paging defaults (P1->notify ops only for confidence>0.8).
2026-03-07 - Engineering review: Decided to implement fusion service in Go for low-latency and use DynamoDB for state. We will expose tunable weights via Console feature flag for safe rollouts.

2026-03-10 - Liam O'Connor: Initial integration tests passing against synthetic dataset; observed 42% reduction in duplicate alerts on dev cluster. Next: run in shadow mode for one week on prod-topology and collect precision/recall metrics.
alerts_and_paging: Mechanism: fused incident emits to alert-service; severity = map(confidence): >0.9=P0, 0.8-0.9=P1-notify-ops, 0.6-0.8=P2-email-only
Escalation: P0 -> immediate PagerDuty, P1 -> Ops channel + on-call if sustained for 15m, P2 -> daily digest
Auto-snooze: if correlated pipeline-health event indicates scheduled maintenance within window, automatically suppress paging and annotate incident
Dedup rules: group by tenant+route_prefix+topo_id to avoid multiple pages for same root cause
test_plan: Unit tests for scoring arithmetic and edge-cases (NaN, zero-variance windows)
Integration tests: synthetic replay that includes late arrivals and simulated Kafka lags; assert reconciliation behavior
Shadow run: 7-day shadow mode in prod with metrics collection: alert_count, dedup_reduction, true_positive_rate (via manual labeling)
Chaos test: simulate Flink job restart and ensure alerts are suppressed if fusion detects maintenance tag
